root: ^General Alcino: You’re back, kid. I trust Captain Pleias has thanked you… he’s already been scolded, though I doubt it will change him much.
^ You—against the orcs—singlehandedly? Now that was most impressive. Of course, I’ll take a little credit—my eye for recruits is unmatched.
^General Alcino: Let the bards wear their voices thin singing your name all week—I won’t complain.
^ But don’t think this is over. The orcs march toward Arun Village, convinced their so-called Cold Fire Stone lies in the elves’ possession. That is… troubling.
^King Merlot: Alcino speaks true. Your courage has stirred both army and town alike.
^ Hope is a rare treasure these days, and you’ve given it freely.
^ For that, you have my thanks. But strength carries duty, and I must place another burden upon you.
^King Merlot: Travel to Arun Village. You’ll find the gate just beyond the bonfire in Snailcliff.
^King Merlot: Alcino will ride at your side. Warn Fenlora, keeper of Arun, so she may ready her defenses before the storm falls upon them.
^King Merlot: Time is short, and words must be fewer still. Know this—I will not forget your service.
^ Your reward will come soon enough. For now, go… and may fortune walk with you.
